Zillow for Warcraft is a promotional collaboration between and Blizzard Entertainment that presents example housing builds from World of Warcraft: Midnight using a real‑estate–style browsing experience modeled after Zillow's home‑listing interface. The website launched on 17 February 2026. The site showcases a curated selection of homes built with the Midnight housing system. Each listing includes room layouts, decor themes, and descriptive write‑ups styled after real‑world property listings. The project is intended to "bring the joy of home‑shopping to Azeroth", while giving players a sense of the creative possibilities of the new housing system. A zone storyline is the primary narrative that guides players through a zone's plot in World of Warcraft. Each zone storyline introduces the region's characters, conflicts, and themes while directing players through major hubs and quest chains. Zone storylines began in , with the previous two "campaigns" being fan-compiled quest lists. Since , zone storylines became more structured and cinematic, and by and later expansions they were formalized as the core progression path for leveling, building up majority of the reputation for relevant factions, and campaign progression. Body armor is used by soldiers to protect themselves against alien weapons and environmental hazards during combat missions. All soldiers are capable of equipping themselves with body armor, except MEC Troopers who equip MEC suits instead. All body armors provide additional HP to soldiers. Damage taken against this "armor HP" does not count towards a soldier being wounded; soldiers will only require recovery time if they lose some of their base health (the green number displayed in their stats screen) during a mission. Alien Alloys are alien artifacts in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. This remarkable substance is the primary material used to manufacture alien technologies, making the alloys an essential resource with many potential applications in various XCOM projects. According to Country Requests, armour plating made from inch-thick alien alloys acts like five-inch steel.

The Abductor is an alien spacecraft in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. It is encountered during UFO landing missions and can be shot down by Interceptors. As its name suggests, it is responsible for the Alien Abductions. The Abductor is a very large ship, and generally requires a full-size squad and good tactics to assault effectively. If encountered during a landing site mission, resistance can be fierce, with numerous aliens, typically Mutons and Floaters occurring in significant numbers. Abductor ships found in rural landing missions are often surrounded by mutilated cattle. The Elite Soldier Pack is a DLC bonus pack for XCOM: Enemy Unknown. This pack adds the following cosmetic options: *Classic X-COM Soldier: Give any soldier the iconic flattop hairstyle from the original X-COM: UFO Defense. *Soldier Deco Packs: Several aesthetic upgrades to armor suits, including the Hyperion and Reaper soldier armor kits. *Complete Color Customization: A variety of colors and tints for all armor sets to customize their squad's look. (A palette of 32 colors for tinting any armor set plus any selected helmet.) The Elite Soldier Pack was only available at launch as a free pre-order bonus but as of October 23rd 2012 it also became a purchasable DLC.

Engineers are XCOM employees who run the Engineering and Workshop facilities at XCOM headquarters in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. Headed by Dr. Shen, engineers manufacture the various weapons, armors, equipment, and aircraft used by your soldiers. They can also upgrade your equipment once you have built a Foundry. You can tell how many engineers you have by visiting Engineering and looking at the bottom-middle of your screen.

ADVENT Coalition is the principal adversary in XCOM 2. Ostensibly a human/alien coalition government, it is in reality a totalitarian imperialist state completely controlled by the aliens, the Elders.

An ADVENT Trooper Corpse is a corpse of an ADVENT Trooper in XCOM 2.
File:XCOM2 Codex idle.gif File:XCOM2 Codex move.gif The Codex is an alien encountered in XCOM 2. It acts as a highly mobile unit, primarily living within the aliens' and ADVENT's computer systems.
An Arc Blade is a secondary weapon in XCOM 2. This upgraded sword-type weapon is restricted to Rangers.
The Commander's Quarters is a facility aboard the Avenger in XCOM 2. Players are able to view the monthly Avenger report, XCOM Archives, and current objectives.
An ADVENT Officer Corpse is a corpse of an ADVENT Officer in XCOM 2.

The Advanced Warfare Center (or AWC) is a aboard the Avenger in XCOM 2. In the XCOM 2: War of the Chosen expansion, this facility cannot be built as its functions are replaced by two new rooms: the Infirmary and the Training Center.

The Advanced Grenade Launcher is an improvement over the conventional Grenade Launcher in XCOM 2. It offers improved range and blast radius over its predecessor, which is an improvement over hand-thrown grenades and bombs, while retaining the full range of ammo options.

An Acid Grenade is an explosive grenade and utility item in XCOM 2. An Acid Bomb is an improved version of the Acid Grenade and comes with the same effects along with more damage and significant armor shred.
The ADVENT Shieldbearer Autopsy is a research project in XCOM 2.
The ADVENT Turret Breakdown is a research project in XCOM 2.
The ADVENT Stun Lancer Autopsy is a research project in XCOM 2.
Experimental Heavy Weapon is a Proving Ground Project in XCOM 2.
Acid Burn is a status effect in XCOM 2. Most biological units and mechanical units are vulnerable, unlike other status effects.

Dark Events are a game mechanic in the single player campaign of XCOM 2 that represents the aliens' progress toward completion of their Avatar Project or counter-insurgency activities efforts aimed at disrupting XCOM's activities. Usually the aliens can be working towards up to 3 Dark Events, each with an individual timer . However, a Chosen can plan to initiate an additional - 4th - Dark Event, which can be countered by a Covert Action of a corresponding Resistance Faction (if such covert action is available). Which Dark Events are currently active can be viewed on the global map under the Dark Events button at the top, along with estimated timers until next Avatar facility construction and

The Bridge is a facility aboard the Avenger in XCOM 2. From this facility the player is able to access the Geoscape, allowing XCOM to search for ADVENT activity and direct the Avenger's movements to help expand the resistance. In the XCOM 2: War of the Chosen Central Officer Bradford talking to Konstantin “Волк” Volikov, the leader of the Reaper Faction.

The Armory is a static facility aboard the Avenger in XCOM 2. From this facility the Commander can view and manage their soldiers: give them promotions, customize their names and appearances, recruit new soldiers, change loadouts, Armors Utility Items and apply Weapon Upgrades.
A Facility Lead is a research project in XCOM 2. Facility Leads can be recovered as hacking rewards; typically from objectives or when using a Skulljack after the Skullmining project.
The E.X.O. Suit Project is a Proving Ground Project in XCOM 2.
The ADVENT Datapad Decryption is a research project in XCOM 2.
An ADVENT MEC Wreck is the wreck of an ADVENT MEC in XCOM 2.
An ADVENT Shieldbearer Corpse is the corpse of an ADVENT Shieldbearer in XCOM 2.
An ADVENT Stun Lancer Corpse is the corpse of an ADVENT Stun Lancer in XCOM 2.
An ADVENT Turret Wreck is the wreck of an ADVENT Turret in XCOM 2.
An Andromedon Wreck is the wreck of an Andromedon in XCOM 2.

The Avatar Autopsy is a research project completed through the Shadow Chamber project in XCOM 2. It can only be done after all other Shadow Chamber projects are complete.
The Alien Data Cache Decryption is a research project in XCOM 2.

An EMP Grenade is an offensive grenade and utility item in XCOM 2. An EMP Bomb is an improved version of the EMP Grenade and comes with the same effects along with more damage, increased radius, and additional tech negation.

The Blacksite Vial (Research) is a research project in XCOM 2. It can be researched in the Shadow Chamber after being recovered from the ADVENT Blacksite mission. It is an integral element of the Avatar Project, containing concentrated human genetic material for over one million beings, to be delivered to subsequent facilities for processing. Completing the research makes the 'ADVENT Forge Facility Assault' mission available. A region with the mission coordinates must be contacted prior to starting the mission.

The Avatar Project is the main mission of ADVENT and The Elders during their presence on Earth. In the story of XCOM 2, it is one of the Commander's primary objectives to discover what the project entails and prevent its completion. Should the Commander fail in this task, they will lose the game.
